violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine were observed with an accumulation of biofilm debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized (scheduled for 11/13); ice disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

Sausage was observed held at 45-51 degrees Fahrenheit above the fill line in the prep unit; butter was held at 45. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Sausage was placed in cold drawers, lid to be closed during pauses in production. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was 0 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for quaternary ammonium sanitizer is 200-400 ppm. Staff refilled bucket. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2025
A staff member was observed not washing hands prior to putting gloves on. Staff directed to wash hands. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2025

Eggs, cheese, and sausage were observed held at 59-63 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Unit was turned on during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2025
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2025

The prep unit is in poor repair. Per PIC, unit "freezes up" during operation. Staff turn off machine during operating hours to defrost. PIC stated work order is in place. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2025
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/22/2023
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/22/2023
